name: The Offering Stone

angles.text: As a Horde adventurer in Silverpine Forest, keep watch for suspicious rituals and cultist activity in the shadowed crags of Beren's Peril.
As a warlock, you may read the dark implements on the offering stone as signs of ritual practice, worth close study.

faq.answer: The Offering Stone is a rough altar in Beren's Peril, Silverpine Forest. Strange implements and items scattered across it point to preparations for an offering or dark rite.
You can find the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril, in southern Silverpine Forest.
faq.q: Where can the Offering Stone be found?

faq.answer: The damaged note does not name the ritualists. Tools and items left on the stone show that someone was preparing an offering or dark rite nearby.
faq.q: Who created or uses the Offering Stone?

faq.answer: Most of the note is weathered and illegible. The surviving fragments mention preparations for a ritual and point to an offering stone nearby.
faq.q: What does the mysterious note say?

aliases: what items are on the stone
faq.answer: Strange tools, ritual implements, and other items lie scattered across the rough stone, meant for an offering.
faq.q: What is found on the Offering Stone?

faq.answer: The note does not fully describe the rite. The stone is prepared as an altar where items or sacrifices are laid out for a ritual.
faq.q: What kind of ritual is being performed here?

sections.body: A weathered scrap found in Silverpine Forest holds fragments about a ritual and an offering stone nearby. Time and moisture have worn away most of its words. Follow the clues into Beren's Peril, and you can find the crude altar in the wilderness.
sections.title: A Tattered Note

sections.body: At Beren's Peril, strange implements and bizarre items lie scattered across the rough stone. Someone has been using the site to prepare an offering or dark rite, far from prying eyes.
sections.title: The Ritual Site

summary: In Beren's Peril, a ritual offering is being prepared at the Offering Stone. Fragments of a weathered note point travelers to the altar in Silverpine Forest.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Offering Stone
